lore.en: You might think the shell Shellshy bought is small, but the clerk at Shellbucks insisted it's a medium. Shellshy was too chicken to argue.
lore.zh: 它觉得自己买到的是小贝壳。但星巴壳的店员坚持对它说，这个是中壳。又因为胆子太小，不敢和店员争辩。

lore.zh: 认为真正的侠客在收招时必须得有个像样的“定格动作”。它现在的最高追求是：赢下战斗后，嘴里的草毫发无损。

lore.zh: 想当说唱歌手但是失败了，现在的梦想是成为乐队中的鼓手。总是在塔塔们的休息时间里练习乐器，被投诉了还会气鼓鼓地瞪着别人。

lore.en: Raised with a clan deep in the mountains to stay safe from the outside world, Surgehoof has no social experience to speak of. Attempts at kindness from Tatari are often misread, and bursts of electricity send them running. The result? Growing loneliness.
lore.zh: 自幼和族群生活在深山里躲避外界袭击，所以完全没有社会经验，常常误会对它表露善意的塔塔，用独角释放的强力电弧吓退它们。一来二去就变得更加孤独了。

lore.zh: 变成了更加不好惹的样子，却意外交到了一些朋友。当它极速奔驰时，鬃毛剧烈放电劈出的强力电波能击倒不少脏兮兮的家伙。同时，它还听到了一些欢呼声。

lore.en: Cribblers were originally ordinary crabs, but marine pollution made them into something more. With a massive left claw, they can shatter enemy shells with ease.

lore.en: Living by the motto of "just stay alive," Clawzor eats little but grows plenty. Surviving in a world overrun with Zobos calls for a unique set of evolutionary rules, after all.
lore.zh: 奉行“活着就行”的原则，厚力蟹吃得少，但长得多。在这个臭臭遍地的破烂世道上存活，当然应该有独特的进化法则。

lore.en: Has a strong sense of justice but is easily misguided. An innocent gopher was once accused as the bad guy, and Shrimpyro charged in without a second thought. Punch first, think later. Plenty of heroic deeds, plenty of enemies to show for it.
lore.zh: 正义感爆棚，但几乎没有辨别能力。曾经有人指着一只无辜的地鼠说“那是坏蛋”，它就二话不说冲上去打出连招。“拳头先行，脑子垫后”的结果就是它做了很多正义的事，却收获了一堆“敌人”。

lore.en: Gifted with incredible talent yet painfully shy, Puncharoo was eventually spotted by Pyroprawn and taken in for training. Unfortunately, Coach Capobeetle's sessions tend to end early, as regular punch bags don't stand a chance against that killer strength.
lore.zh: 拥有无敌的天赋却异常胆小，直到被极火虾发现，于是把它抓去训练。由酷甲虫教练制定的练习计划，却总是因为它用天生神力把拳套打破而草草收场。

lore.zh: 戴上墨镜之后就没人能看到它胆怯的眼神。当它感受到巨大的威胁时，潜意识里的拳击天赋会瞬间接管身体。看着被打趴的满地入侵者……呃，它真的只是想让这些家伙离它远一点。

lore.zh: 当为了保护同伴陷入重围时，慌乱化作了极致的冷静。不再闭着眼睛胡乱挥舞，而是用绝对专注的眼神锁定目标，随后挥出足以撕裂一切的一拳。

lore.en: Skinklet tries so hard to avoid everyone, Tatari and Zobos alike. Still, hiding doesn't always work... especially when blending into a seat cushion and getting sat on.
lore.zh: 明明已经很努力避开所有人、塔塔、臭臭了，但还是经常被人发现。比如它趴在坐垫上与之融为一体的时候，被别的塔塔一屁股坐上去。

text.en: Purchase any 5 buildings. Give Skinklet a hiding spot!
text.zh: 购买5个任意建筑，给水滴蜥提供藏身之处

description.en: Launches bubbles to deal AoE damage. Becomes Invisible after taking a certain amount of damage. Prioritizes attacking enemies in the back while Invisible.

lore.en: What's wrong with carrying all your favorite snacks around? You'll hardly get hungry, and they're extra handy when Zobos come around. Perfect, don't you think?

lore.en: Jarachnid despises filthy, smelly Zobos, yet still steps up whenever they come near. The earth's precious environment is all we have, and Jarachnid protects it with every bit of power available.
lore.zh: 明明最讨厌脏兮兮的臭臭们，但是当它们靠近的时候，还是会挡在最前面。不希望环境遭受任何破坏的叶瓶蛛，用它自己的力量守护着这个世界。

lore.en: After hearing about a flower near the mudflats out east, Gemsnail set out at dawn to see it and finally arrived by nightfall. Turns out, the flower only blooms at night. Slow and steady is the way to go.
lore.zh: 东边那块滩涂旁长出了一朵小花，可以去看看它。就这样想着，晶石蜗牛清晨出发，深夜终于抵达。那朵小花，竟然是夜晚开放的哦。事急则缓，事缓则圆啊。

text.zh: 让10个弹珠落入星星袋子，星光闪闪！

lore.zh: 每一个旋转动作都能引发欢呼，将战场变成盛大的星光舞池。它坚信笑容和节奏可以拯救世界，只要它的舞步不停，伙伴们就会拥有无穷无尽的动力。

lore.en: Having attained enlightenment, Cactobodhi is now without thorns and simply passes the flower season peacefully with eyes closed. While those who are foolish enough still approach to get skewered, know that it's done so with great compassion.
lore.zh: 收起尖刺，迎来花期，它已然参透一切。如今的它只是闭目捧着那朵祥和之花，用最慈悲的姿态，静静扎穿每一个不知死活的靠近者。

lore.en: Ask Humbleetle why that dark, gooey stuff is worth eating, and get ready for an earnest breakdown of age, origin, and fermentation process. Most Tatari last for a couple of minutes before their stomachs start to hurl.
lore.zh: 如果有谁问它为什么吃这团黑乎乎的东西，它会认真地科普这东西的年份、产地和发酵过程，直到某些塔塔听得胃部翻涌、狼狈离开。

The signature favorite has now crystallized into a triangular talisman embedded with a mysterious eye; when held high, not only does it expose the weakness of all within view, but also delivers the swiftest judgement of annihilation.

lore.en: No longer content with weaving fleeting illusions, Ecstamira wants to shape even the living world into a place for sleeping. With spores that can lull the noisiest of Zobos into dazzling dreams, who knows when they'll wake up? Not until the entire world grows quiet, at least.
lore.zh: 不再满足于编织短暂的幻境，而是把现实也改造成适合睡觉的样子。孢子能让最吵闹的臭臭都沉浸到绚丽的梦中。至于什么时候醒来？等这个世界学会安静再说。

lore.zh: 所谓功德就是把过去敲到消失？不，是在下一次做出更好的选择。木槌落下时，空灵的声响会让所有人沉静下来。嗒——嗒——别急，一个一个来，它今天很有耐心。

lore.zh: 在它眼里，周围那些蹦蹦跳跳的塔塔除了制造噪音和麻烦外一无是处。如果没有它在这里守着，这群连左右都分不清的笨家伙，恐怕连明天早上的太阳都见不到。

text.zh: 携带小舌驼参与臭潮来袭3次，用口水淹没臭臭们！

text.zh: 当目标为其他塔塔时，技能伤害将在原始伤害基础上乘以「竞技系数」。不同技能的竞技系数各不相同

description.en: Periodically grants DMG Boost to nearby allies.
description.zh: 周期性给予周围伙伴「增伤」

description.en: Shoots sticky spit to deal AoE damage and leaves behind a Strong Slow Zone.
description.zh: 吐粘稠口水，造成范围伤害并留下「强力减速区域」

description.en: Spits continuously in the direction of recent movement. Prioritizes locking onto bosses.
description.zh: 向最后一次移动的方向，持续不断地吐口水。会优先锁定首领进行攻击

lore.en: All that overgrown fur is home to a thriving micro ecosystem. Don't shy away when Blechlama charges at you carrying the raw, powerful scent of nature—embrace the call of the untamed wild!
lore.zh: 疯长的毛发已演化为繁荣的微观生态区。当它裹挟着自然发酵的气息向你狂奔而来时，记得不要躲避，去拥抱这世上最包罗万象的生命吧！

description.en: Shoots small globs of spit at single enemies to deal multiple instances of damage, or a large glob at enemy crowds to deal small AoE damage and inflict Bind. Also creates a Slow Zone. Blechlama carries Aura: Grass whenever on the field.
description.zh: 向落单的敌人吐小口水，造成数次伤害，或向聚集的敌人吐大口水，造成小范围伤害和「禁锢」，并留下「减速区域」。拥有「光环-草」

text.en: Enemies inside the zone are inflicted with Slow.
text.zh: 区域上的敌人会被「减速」

text.en: Increases Max HP for all allies. The effect for non-Grass allies is reduced by 50%. Aura: Grass can be stacked, but cannot take effect in some game modes.
text.zh: 提升所有伙伴的生命。其他元素伙伴的提升效果为草元素伙伴的50%。「光环-草」可叠加以增强效果。在部分玩法中不生效

lore.en: Convinced those claws can pierce through anything. If not, it's because Drilleroo was holding back.
lore.zh: 坚信自己的爪子拥有钻开一切的硬度，如果没有……只是它刚刚爪下留情罢了。

text.zh: 给小穿山投喂3份晶石塔可。咔嚓——

description.en: Swipes claws to deal AoE damage. Sometimes launches a heavy attack that inflicts Knockback on enemies to force them into adjacent rows, or inflicts Shredded on enemies that cannot be knocked back.
description.zh: 横扫，造成范围伤害。有时会重击，将敌人「击退」至其他列，对无法被击退的敌人造成「撕裂」

text.en: Forcibly retreats a small distance. Cannot take effect on Tatari and certain Zobos.
text.zh: 强制位移一小段距离。对塔塔和部分臭臭不生效

text.en: Upon taking damage, Shredded is triggered for extra damage.
text.zh: 受到伤害时，会触发「撕裂」造成的额外伤害

description.en: Attacks have a chance to launch an extra stab forward, dealing AoE damage and inflicting DEF Down. Gains Stab: DEF Boost based on the number of enemies hit.
description.zh: 攻击时有概率额外向前方刺击，造成范围伤害和「防御降低」，并基于命中敌人数量获得「刺击-防御提升」

description.en: Periodically gains a Sunder Shield. Value of the shield is based on the number of enemies nearby. The more enemies, the higher the shield value.
description.zh: 周期性获得「穿山盾」，护盾值随周围敌人数量提升

description.en: Able to move above the deployment area. Periodically gains Prepared. After moving, expends Prepared to deal large AoE damage. When in Danger, retreats and recovers HP while losing this skill's effect for some time.
description.zh: 可移动至布阵区域外。周期性获得「就绪」，移动结束时消耗「就绪」造成大范围伤害。「危险」时后退，治疗自己并失去该技能效果一段时间

lore.en: To Cragolin, digging tunnels is nothing less than reshaping the world. Not everyone agrees, especially when those tunnels cut right through Watchroo homes.
lore.zh: 不觉得自己在钻洞，认为自己在重塑世界。经常因为挖隧道挖到前哨鼠的家里而发生争吵。

text.en: Feed Cragolin to increase stats 3 time(s).
text.zh: 通过喂养提升大钻山的属性3次

lore.zh: 稍微有点动静就会惊慌失措，扑棱着翅膀到处乱撞，但由于飞不起来，只能跑到黑暗的角落躲藏。

text.zh: 臭潮来袭中将电音蝠升到Lv.5及以上，累计1次

lore.en: Thanks to those enlarged ears and sensitive nerves, Synthhog notices every tiny sound. Still, more often than not, it is the shadow underfoot that sends everything into a panic.
lore.zh: 拥有了更大的耳朵和更敏感的神经，一点点风吹草动都会让它仔细打量四周——虽然大多数时候，它只是在被自己的影子吓得四处乱窜。

lore.zh: 会趁着塔塔们都睡着的夜晚，发出能令臭臭昏迷的超声波，给自己制造一个完全安静的环境……如果呼噜刺也不发出声音就更好了。

lore.en: Umbraveil has overcome fear completely and emerged as the graceful lord of the night. When soaring in the skies, those sound waves can even sunder space itself. There's no need to hide under the cover of night now, for Umbraveil's powers have far surpassed even the one who was once revered.
lore.zh: 完全克服了恐惧，化身优雅的暗夜贵族。它终于展翅腾空，用足以撕裂空间的声波粉碎一切来犯之敌。现在的它无须躲进黑夜寻觅庇护，因为它比当初所崇拜的存在更强大。

lore.en: Those bulging, unblinking eyes give off an eerie sense of knowing, as if resigned to fateful gloom from the shadows. But don't be deceived, for Maskfry is always checking if your scent is worthy of the Dagon.
lore.zh: 它那对永不闭合的、凸出的死鱼眼透着令人不安的智慧。小骨鱼总是蹲在阴影里，带着某种宿命般的忧郁凝视着你。别被它呆滞的外表骗了，它正通过你身上的咸腥味，确认你是否拥有那份“印斯茅斯”的血脉。

text.en: Use Maskfry in 10 Boss Challenge attempts. Drag enemies into the abyss!
text.zh: 携带小骨鱼参与首领挑战10次，将敌人拖入深渊吧！

lore.en: Bones of blasphemy now bulge from Ospisces's back, who's developed an aversion to freshwater. At night, wet, guttural murmurs fill the air, as if repeated from an ancient chant. You might find strange, sprawling doodles in the bathtub, along with what looks like a ritual sacrifice of your slippers to a mysterious being.
lore.zh: 刺骨鱼的背部隆起了亵渎的骨刺，且开始表现出对淡水的极度蔑视。它总在深夜发出黏糊糊的喉音，像是某种古老圣咏的练习。它最近迷上了在浴缸里涂鸦扭曲的几何图形，并试图把你的拖鞋献祭给那个传说中的它。

text.zh: 通过喂养提升刺骨鱼的属性3次

lore.en: There's no turning back now. Armorjaw has outgrown the basin, quietly charting a course toward Devil's Reef. When an attempt to reach out is given, only a cold, distant stare is returned, as if quietly questioning your allegiance to humanity.
lore.zh: 转变已不可逆转，铠骨鱼已经不再满足于在脸盆里扑腾，而是开始在地图上勾画前往恶魔礁的路线。当你试图教它握手时，它却在用那双冰冷的眼睛审视你：人类的文明，真的值得留恋吗？

lore.en: Dagondeep is the living tide, a presence that haunts dreams with quiet terror. An ancient body encased in layered scales of armor, each movement echoes the tremors of R'lyeh. Now, the webbed hand beckons: Come, master. There is no need to breathe beneath the sea... and the rent is far cheaper.
lore.zh: 它是潮汐的化身，是那个在梦境中不断呼唤的恐怖源头。它身披鳞片堆砌的重甲，每一个动作都带着拉莱耶的震颤。现在，它正温柔地向你伸出布满蹼爪的手：走吧，主人，海面下的生活不需要呼吸，而且那里的房租远比陆地便宜。

lore.en: Chronerva claims to be able to freeze time. Just look at Souverelle who falls still as soon as the chanting starts. Now that's a powerful, intelligent Tatari if you ask me!
lore.zh: 认为自己差不多练成了让时间停滞的魔法，不信可以看看爱洛公主，总是在它念出咒语之后就一动不动了。多么博学多才又法力高强的塔塔啊。

text.zh: 拥有25枚徽章，圣叶鸮想要变得更有学问！

lore.en: Time is a cycle that nudges the hands of fate. When the pendulum swings back, we'll be reunited with those we've lost.
lore.zh: 时间是圆，万物轮回。它俯瞰着命运的刻度，轻轻拨动指针。当钟摆倒转、刻度重合的那一秒，失散之人，一定会回到彼此身边。

description.en: Launches #.SArg3# ricocheting orbs that deal damage to enemies and inflict Paralysis. Grants allies 1 stack of Glow.
description.zh: 发射#.SArg3#个电球在战场中弹射，对敌人造成伤害和「麻痹」，给予伙伴1层「荧光」

description.en: Fires a lightning bolt that deals damage to enemies and inflicts Paralysis. Grants allies 1 stack of Glow.
description.zh: 向前发射一道电光，对敌人造成伤害和「麻痹」，对伙伴给予1层「荧光」

description.en: Grants allies in front 1 stack of stackable Glow.
description.zh: 给予前方范围的伙伴1层可叠加的「荧光」

lore.en: Snowcub has a great appetite but not so great hunting skills. After finally catching one fish, Snowcub now brings it everywhere as a bluff to cover the fact that there's no catching another one any time soon.
lore.zh: 极其贪吃却偏偏不擅长捕猎。好不容易抓到一条鱼，便天天叼在嘴里四处溜达，企图用这种虚张声势的方式，掩饰自己根本抓不到下一条鱼的尴尬事实。

text.en: Feed Snowcub any 30 food items. Gotta eat!
text.zh: 给贪吃熊投喂30份任意食物，填饱肚子是第一要务！

description.en: Throws #.SArg1# fish in turn to deal AoE damage. Carries Foodie: Fragile. When in Danger, eats 1 fish to recover HP and dispel all other debuffs.
description.zh: 拥有#.SArg1#条鱼，依次扔出所有鱼造成范围伤害。拥有「馋嘴-易伤」，「危险」时吃掉1条鱼，治疗自己并驱散其他减益效果

text.en: After taking damage, HP will drop below 10%.
text.zh: 受到伤害后，生命将会低于10%

text.en: When a skill targets another Tatari, the skill's base damage is multiplied by an Arena Factor, which varies depending on the skill.
text.zh: 当目标为其他塔塔时，技能伤害将在原始伤害基础上乘以「竞技系数」。不同技能的竞技系数各不相同

description.en: Attacks have a chance to create 1 cola. The cola is either thrown to deal small AoE damage, or drunk to recover HP and obtain Cola: DMG Boost.
description.zh: 攻击时，有概率生成1瓶可乐、扔出1瓶可乐造成小范围伤害、或喝掉1瓶可乐治疗自己并获得「可乐-增伤」

description.en: Throws 1 small fish that attracts bigger fish and marlins to deal damage to enemies in their path.
description.zh: 扔出1条小鱼，并吸引大鱼和旗鱼，依次对路径上的敌人造成伤害

description.en: Places #.SArg3# cola baits that attract fish to deal small AoE damage. After, Large Marlin shares cola with all allies on the field, granting Cola: ATK & DEF Boost.
description.zh: 摆放#.SArg3#个可乐鱼饵，鱼饵分别上鱼造成小范围伤害。随后鱼神向所有伙伴分享可乐，给予「可乐-攻防提升」

lore.en: Polarpaw is gradually learning to discern the distinct smell of fish, the flow of currents, and movement patterns beneath the ice. Although sometimes the prey turns out to be seaweed, random sticks of wood, and even Polarpaw's own shadow, this is all part of the masterplan. At least, that's what Polarpaw would tell you.
lore.zh: 它开始认真研究鱼的气味、水流和冰层下的动静。虽然经常把海草、木棍和自己的影子误认为猎物，但它已经学会了装作“这一切都在侦查计划中”。

text.en: Feed Polarpaw to increase stats 3 times.
text.zh: 通过喂养提升摸鱼熊的属性3次

text.en: Use Fishing Rod x2000 in the Fishing Contest.
text.zh: 钓鱼大赛中消耗2000个鱼竿

lore.en: Having adapted to the harsh environments, Blizzgrizz's hunting abilities are steadily improving. The catch of the day is carefully collected into the creel, then brought to the kitchen at camp. While acting like it's nothing special, Blizzgrizz will always secretly look out for a nod of approval.
lore.zh: 适应了严酷的环境，捕捞技巧日益精进。它会把冰海里的收获整齐码进随身鱼篓，再郑重送到营地那张料理台旁。虽然它总装作只是顺路，但每次离开前都会偷偷确认对方有没有点头。

text.en: Feed this Tatari to B quality.
Use Fishing Rod x6000 in the Fishing Contest.
text.zh: 钓鱼大赛中消耗6000个鱼竿
给来势熊熊投喂15份破浪寿司船

lore.en: The searing snow is Anglerbear's playground, and hunting is as easy as a game. An entertaining one, too, especially if the prey are cunning enough to attempt escape.
lore.zh: 享受穿梭风雪的乐趣。如今的追击对它而言，只是一场极具观赏性的游戏。无论面对多么狡猾的目标，它都能轻松赢下这场角逐。

description.en: Throws #.SArg1# fish in turn to deal AoE damage. Carries Foodie: Fragile. When in Danger, shares 1 fish with an ally to recover HP and dispel all other debuffs for both. Anglerbear carries Aura: Water whenever on the field.
description.zh: 拥有#.SArg1#条鱼，依次扔出所有鱼造成范围伤害。拥有「馋嘴-易伤」，「危险」时分享并吃掉1条鱼，治疗自己和1个伙伴，并驱散其他减益效果。拥有「光环-水」

text.en: After taking damage, HP will drop below 10%.
text.zh: 受到伤害后，生命将会低于10%

text.en: Heals all allies continuously. The healing effect for non-Water allies is reduced by 50%. Aura: Water can be stacked, but cannot take effect in some game modes.
text.zh: 持续治疗所有伙伴。其他元素伙伴的治疗效果为水元素伙伴的50%。「光环-水」可叠加以增强效果。在部分玩法中不生效

lore.en: Enjoys drifting in the hot springs at the foot of a volcano. Sometimes gets pushed along by the sizzling bubbles before realizing the surroundings have changed.
lore.zh: 生活在火山脚下的温泉中，喜欢跟随热乎乎的水流慢慢漂游。偶尔被咕嘟冒起的气泡顶走，它也要过一会儿才发现自己换了地方。

text.zh: 给泡泡蝌投喂10个辣椒苏打

description.en: Spits flames, dealing AoE damage and inflicting Burn. Sometimes spits flames non-stop, continuously dealing AoE damage.
description.zh: 喷火，造成范围伤害和「灼烧」。有时会持续喷火，造成范围持续伤害

text.zh: 当目标为其他塔塔时，技能伤害将在原始伤害基础上乘以「竞技系数」。不同技能的竞技系数各不相同

description.en: When moving, instantly reaches the target location and grants nearby allies DMG Boost and ATK Boost.
description.zh: 移动时可以立即到达，并给予目标位置的周围伙伴「增伤」和「攻击提升」

description.en: Shares a mesmerizing song and continuously inflicts Stun over a large area to the front.
description.zh: 一展歌喉，持续对前方大范围造成「眩晕」

description.en: Sprays scalding oil over a large area to the front, inflicting Oil: Slow. After, the oil ignites to continuously deal damage and inflict Burn. A final explosion deals follow-up damage.
description.zh: 对前方大范围喷洒热油，造成「热油-减速」。随后热油燃烧，造成持续伤害和「灼烧」，最终爆燃造成追加伤害

lore.en: Loves to press close to the ground, silently sensing distant vibrations as well as changes in temperature and humidity. Whether it's the best resting spot in camp or the newest Zobo hideout, Sizzribb can always tell beforehand, although it'll take some time to actually get moving.
lore.zh: 喜欢把肚皮贴在地上，安静感受温度、湿度和远处传来的震动。哪里适合休息，哪里有臭臭靠近，它其实早就知道了，只是还没开始动。

text.en: Feed Sizzribb to increase stats 3 time(s).
text.zh: 通过喂养提升火蟾蜍的属性3次

text.en: In Island Goldrush, use Energy Drink x5000.
text.zh: 在海岛夺金中消耗5000瓶能量饮料

lore.en: "Lickflickers learn about the world by putting things in their mouths, so keep a close eye on your food, gloves, and valuables—especially anything sensitive to heat." —Tatari Observation Diary
lore.zh: 认识新东西的方法是先含在嘴里感受。请看好自己的饭团、手套和贵重物品，尤其是那些不适合被加热的东西。——《塔塔观察日记》

text.zh: 给卷舌蟾蜍投喂15份火山披萨

lore.en: Ignitoad's breath is like a slow, churning current of volcanic heat, scorching the earth beneath. The flames that devour Ignitoad's enemies don't come from rage, however, but rather an attempt to keep the ambient temperature just right.
lore.zh: 它的呼吸像火山深处缓慢翻涌的热流，连脚下的土地都会随之发烫。那片吞没敌人的火海并非来自愤怒，只是它在确认周围的温度是否刚刚好。

description.en: Spits flames, dealing large AoE damage and inflicting Burn. Sometimes spits flames non-stop, continuously dealing large AoE damage. Consumes Burn on targets to deal follow-up damage. Ignitoad carries Aura: Fire whenever on the field.
description.zh: 喷火，造成大范围伤害和「灼烧」。有时会持续喷火，造成大范围持续伤害，并消耗目标的「灼烧」，对其造成追加伤害。拥有「光环-火」

lore.en: A mysterious little sprout that prefers to stay hidden in dark, secluded corners. Doesn't know how to say no and often gets dragged out by Buddi for a sunbath.
lore.zh: 行踪神秘难测，喜欢待在不为人知的隐秘角落。但因为不懂拒绝，经常被盆盆葵强行拉出去晒太阳。

text.zh: 在营地商店购买10个任意建筑

description.en: Shoots a seed to deal single-target damage. Sometimes shoots a venomous seed to deal small AoE damage and inflict Poison.
description.zh: 发射种子，造成单体伤害。有时会发射剧毒种子，造成小范围伤害和「中毒」

text.en: Takes increased damage and continuously takes damage.
text.zh: 受到的伤害提升，并持续受到伤害

text.en: When a skill targets another Tatari, the skill's base damage is multiplied by an Arena Factor, which varies depending on the skill.
text.zh: 当目标为其他塔塔时，技能伤害将在原始伤害基础上乘以「竞技系数」。不同技能的竞技系数各不相同

description.en: Has a chance to apply 1 stack of Bane when inflicting Poison. Also has a chance to deal small AoE damage when applying Bane.
description.zh: 造成「中毒」时有概率额外施加1层「宿毒」，施加「宿毒」时有概率额外造成小范围伤害

description.en: Periodically launches #.SArg5# shadows to deal single-target damage and apply 1 stack of Bane. Shadows will pierce enemies with Bane.
description.zh: 周期性发射#.SArg5#只暗影，造成单体伤害和1层「宿毒」。暗影会穿透已有「宿毒」的敌人

description.en: Summons many shadows to deal large AoE damage, inflicting 1 stack of Bane and doubling the enemy's current stacks. Prioritizes attacking bosses.
description.zh: 呼唤大量幽影，造成大范围伤害，对敌人施加1层「宿毒」并使其「宿毒」层数翻倍。会优先锁定首领进行攻击

lore.en: Snapshade was supposed to be temporary decor when the party ran out of flowers, but ended up sticking around. Oof! Do plants usually try to trip every Tatari passing by?
lore.zh: 派对缺花时的临时装饰！本以为它会直接离场，结果竟乖乖留下来当起了盆景。不对……它正试图绊倒每一个路过的塔塔。

text.en: Feed Snapshade to increase stats 3 times.
text.zh: 通过喂养提升幽影花的属性3次

description.en: Shoots a seed to deal single-target damage. Sometimes shoots #.SArg2# venomous seeds to deal small AoE damage and inflict Poison.
description.zh: 发射种子，造成单体伤害。有时会发射#.SArg2#颗剧毒种子，造成小范围伤害和「中毒」

text.en: Takes increased damage and continuously takes damage.
text.zh: 受到的伤害提升，并持续受到伤害

text.en: When a skill targets another Tatari, the skill's base damage is multiplied by an Arena Factor, which varies depending on the skill.
text.zh: 当目标为其他塔塔时，技能伤害将在原始伤害基础上乘以「竞技系数」。不同技能的竞技系数各不相同

description.en: Has a chance to apply 1 stack of Bane when inflicting Poison. Also has a chance to deal small AoE damage when applying Bane.
description.zh: 造成「中毒」时有概率额外施加1层「宿毒」，施加「宿毒」时有概率额外造成小范围伤害

description.en: Periodically launches #.SArg5# shadows to deal single-target damage and apply 1 stack of Bane. Shadows will pierce enemies with Bane.
description.zh: 周期性发射#.SArg5#只暗影，造成单体伤害和1层「宿毒」。暗影会穿透已有「宿毒」的敌人

description.en: Summons many shadows to deal large AoE damage, inflicting 1 stack of Bane and doubling the enemy's current stacks. Prioritizes attacking bosses.
description.zh: 呼唤大量幽影，造成大范围伤害，对敌人施加1层「宿毒」并使其「宿毒」层数翻倍。会优先锁定首领进行攻击

lore.en: Thornwisp loves to cast a menacing shadow, taking pleasure in watching Tatari get scared and scatter. But on cold nights, Thornwisp will secretly extend branches to shield sleeping Tatari from the wind.
lore.zh: 喜欢把影子拉得很狰狞，看见其他塔塔吓得绕道会暗自得意。可到了寒夜，还是会悄悄延展身上的枝条，给熟睡的塔塔们挡挡风。

text.en: Feed this Tatari to B quality.

text.zh: 给幻影花投喂120份任意食物

description.en: Shoots a seed to deal single-target damage. Sometimes shoots #.SArg2# venomous seeds to deal small AoE damage and inflict Poison. Also creates a Poison Zone.
description.zh: 发射种子，造成单体伤害。有时会发射#.SArg2#颗剧毒种子，造成小范围伤害和「中毒」，并留下「中毒区域」

text.en: Takes increased damage and continuously takes damage.
text.zh: 受到的伤害提升，并持续受到伤害

text.en: Enemies inside the zone are inflicted with Poison. If a venomous seed misses an enemy, it will still create a Poison Zone before disappearing.
text.zh: 区域上的敌人会「中毒」。剧毒种子未命中敌人时，也会在消失前留下「中毒区域」

lore.en: Chomperwraith's massive flower crown finally sprouted, looking like a movie supervillain. Zobos fear the gaping maw, but fellow Tatari find the shadow it casts to be the safest place of all.
lore.zh: 终于长出了庞大的花冠，看上去像是电影里的超级反派。臭臭们恐惧这个能吞噬一切的巨口，但在同伴眼里，它阴影笼罩的地方，就是最安全的堡垒。

description.zh: 发射种子，造成单体伤害。有时会发射#.SArg2#颗剧毒种子，造成小范围伤害和「中毒」，并留下「中毒区域」。拥有「光环-草」

text.en: Increases Max HP for all allies. The effect for non-Grass allies is reduced by 50%. Aura: Grass can be stacked, but cannot take effect in some game modes.
text.zh: 提升所有伙伴的生命。其他元素伙伴的提升效果为草元素伙伴的50%。「光环-草」可叠加以增强效果。在部分玩法中不生效

text.zh: 当目标为其他塔塔时，技能伤害将在原始伤害基础上乘以「竞技系数」。不同技能的竞技系数各不相同

name.zh: 四阶通用光环（不用翻译）

lore.en: Ringtail is an expert at finding things without owners somehow. Cookies left on the bakery counter, fresh fruit from the market... and since everything's shared among four, Ringtail always makes a point to grab just a couple extra.
lore.zh: 总能找到“无人看管”的物品：烘焙店柜台上的饼干、水果店里的鲜果……对了，一块饼干要分成四份，嗯……还是多拿一点吧。

text.en: Obtain a total of 50 of the following foods: Cookies, Rock Sugar Rings, Gem Tacos, or Stone Cakes (any combination).
text.zh: 获得饼干、岩粒糖圈、晶石塔可或岩石蛋糕，共50份

description.en: Orders Lackeys to continuously deal AoE damage. After Lackeys return, provides healing and Vigilante: ATK Boost to allies within a small area.
description.zh: 呼唤「跟班」造成范围持续伤害，随后「跟班」回归，给予较小范围伙伴治疗和「侠盗-攻击提升」

text.en: Attackable units that provide additional healing and ATK Boost upon returning. Will leave and disappear after getting hit a certain amount of times.
text.zh: 可被攻击的单位，成功回归后提升治疗和攻击提升效果。受到一定次数伤害后会掉队，无法回归

text.en: ATK increases based on the caster's ATK.
text.zh: 攻击提升。提升数值基于来源的攻击

text.en: When a skill targets another Tatari, the skill's base damage is multiplied by an Arena Factor, which varies depending on the skill.
text.zh: 当目标为其他塔塔时，技能伤害将在原始伤害基础上乘以「竞技系数」。不同技能的竞技系数各不相同

description.en: Periodically steals ATK and HP from #.SArg3# allies. Gives them back later while additionally granting healing and Returns: ATK Boost.
description.zh: 周期性偷取#.SArg3#个伙伴的攻击和生命，一段时间后返还并额外给予治疗和「回报-攻击提升」

description.en: Periodically throws gold coins to one tile. When allies pick up coins, they gain Ka-Ching: DMG Boost.
description.zh: 周期性向1个空格投掷金币，伙伴可以拾取金币获得「金币-增伤」

description.en: Periodically locks onto targets and charges a cannon. Upon impact, deals single-target damage and inflicts Hugs: Stun. Deals follow-up damage when stun ends, and prioritizes attacking bosses.
description.zh: 周期性使用礼炮锁定目标并蓄力，发射命中后造成单体伤害和「抱住-眩晕」，眩晕结束时造成追加伤害。会优先锁定首领进行攻击

lore.en: Rizzler figured wearing a mask keeps you safe from being recognized, but that charming smirk and familiar figure already left their mark in the hearts of many.
lore.zh: 学会了带上眼罩就没人能认得出自己的“掩耳盗铃”战略。但是那狡黠的笑容和经常出没的身影，早已经被人深深记住啦。

text.en: Feed Rizzler to increase stats 3 times.
text.zh: 通过喂养提升改头浣面的属性3次

text.en: Dig up treasure x40 in Treasure Hunt.
text.zh: 营地寻宝中挖开40个含宝藏的地块

lore.en: Zorrock is no lowly thief, but a con artist who plans out the perfect style, timing, and escape route. The moment people notice something's gone missing—that's when Zorrock makes a dramatic entrance up high, leaving onlookers stunned before disappearing without a trace.
lore.zh: 才不是什么小毛贼，它可是讲究姿态、时机和退场路线的怪盗。最喜欢在大家发现东西不见的那一刻，从高处潇洒现身，再趁所有人愣住的时候逃得无影无踪。

text.en: Feed this Tatari to B quality.
Dig up treasure x120 in Treasure Hunt.

lore.en: If you want to take on Phantothief, keep a tight watch on the cookies, keys, and other pretty trinkets in your pocket. Between the seductive smiles and gestures, however, this handsome thief just might snatch something even more precious. Someone's heart, perhaps?
lore.zh: 和它交手时，别只顾着看紧口袋里的饼干、钥匙和漂亮装饰。它会在行礼、微笑和帅气退场之间，顺手偷走最重要的东西。没错，那就是某人的心。

lore.en: Cavyzap has always been extremely insecure and is never seen outside the cage. But don't be mistaken—the cage isn't a prison but a safehouse. As long as the house is there, Cavyzap isn't afraid to give passing Zobos the stink eye.
lore.zh: 天生极度缺乏安全感，紧紧抓着笼子不肯松手。别误会，这可不是囚牢，而是它亲自认证的安全屋。只要待在里面，它甚至敢用眼神狠狠谴责路过的臭臭。

text.en: Kill 300 Zobos while clearing stages. Cavyzap wants to feel safe!
text.zh: 在推关中击杀300只臭臭，增加天笼鼠的安全感！

description.en: Shoots an Electricage orb that deals small AoE damage and creates an Electricage. Fires piercing signals towards the Electricage after, creating an electric surge that deals small AoE damage upon impact.
description.zh: 发射电笼球，造成小范围伤害并创造「电笼」。随后向「电笼」发射可穿透的信号球，命中「电笼」时电涌造成小范围伤害。

text.en: Deals small AoE damage continuously and inflicts additional effects on some affected enemies. If targets are bosses or other Tatari, reduces their ATK Speed and Move Speed; if not, inflicts Bind.
text.zh: 造成小范围持续伤害，并对其中部分敌人造成额外效果。若目标为首领或其他塔塔时，降低攻速与移动速度，否则造成「禁锢」

text.en: When a skill targets another Tatari, the skill's base damage is multiplied by an Arena Factor, which varies depending on the skill.
text.zh: 当目标为其他塔塔时，技能伤害将在原始伤害基础上乘以「竞技系数」。不同技能的竞技系数各不相同

description.en: Attacks have a chance to create an additional smaller Electricage, which continuously deals small AoE damage and inflicts Bind or Electricage: Move SPD & ATK SPD Down on some affected enemies.
description.zh: 攻击时有概率额外创造1个小电笼，造成小范围持续伤害，并对其中部分敌人造成「禁锢」或「电笼-移速及攻速降低」

description.en: Creates 2 bounce devices. Orbs will ricochet between devices and deal damage to enemies in their path.
description.zh: 创造2个弹球机器。电球会在机器间弹射，对路径上的敌人造成伤害

description.en: Periodically summons Cavyzap allies that form an electric current connection to deal damage to enemies in their path.
description.zh: 周期性召唤天笼鼠伙伴们，传递电流并对路径上的敌人造成伤害

lore.en: The cage has been upgraded to a cozy home. Although usually only brave enough to peek through the door, Hippiehog will angrily (but quietly) let potential intruders know that they are not welcome.
lore.zh: 终于把笼子升级成了结实的小窝。平时只敢从门缝里观察世界，但只要谁敢靠近它的屋檐，它就会立刻探出半个身子，气势汹汹地发出非常小声的警告。

text.en: Feed Hippiehog to increase stats 3 times.
text.zh: 通过喂养提升窝居鼠的属性3次

lore.en: Wheekroller is no longer a homebody and has fallen in love with running. The windmill keeps on spinning ahead and it feels like flying! For some reason the scenery hasn't changed, but as far as Wheekroller is concerned it's the top of the world.
lore.zh: 不再宅家躲避视线，彻底迷上了奔跑！头顶风车呼呼转动，脚下跑轮越来越快，虽然仍在原地，但它已经单方面宣布自己征服了世界。

text.en: Feed this Tatari to B quality.

description.en: Shoots an Electricage orb that deals small AoE damage and creates an Electricage. Fires piercing signals towards the Electricage after, creating an electric surge that deals AoE damage upon impact.
description.zh: 发射电笼球，造成小范围伤害并创造「电笼」。随后向「电笼」发射可穿透的信号球，命中「电笼」时电涌造成范围伤害。

text.en: Deals small AoE damage continuously and inflicts additional effects on some affected enemies. If targets are bosses or other Tatari, reduces their ATK Speed and Move Speed; if not, inflicts Bind.
text.zh: 造成小范围持续伤害，并对其中部分敌人造成额外效果。若目标为首领或其他塔塔时，降低攻速与移动速度，否则造成「禁锢」

text.en: When a skill targets another Tatari, the skill's base damage is multiplied by an Arena Factor, which varies depending on the skill.
text.zh: 当目标为其他塔塔时，技能伤害将在原始伤害基础上乘以「竞技系数」。不同技能的竞技系数各不相同

description.en: Attacks have a chance to create an additional smaller Electricage, which continuously deals small AoE damage and inflicts Bind or Electricage: Move SPD & ATK SPD Down on some affected enemies.
description.zh: 攻击时有概率额外创造1个小电笼，造成小范围持续伤害，并对其中部分敌人造成「禁锢」或「电笼-移速及攻速降低」

description.en: Creates 2 bounce devices. Orbs will ricochet between devices and deal damage to enemies in their path.
description.zh: 创造2个弹球机器。电球会在机器间弹射，对路径上的敌人造成伤害

description.en: Periodically summons Cavyzap allies that form an electric current connection to deal damage to enemies in their path.
description.zh: 周期性召唤天笼鼠伙伴们，传递电流并对路径上的敌人造成伤害

lore.en: The ultimate solution to feeling insecure is to become the strongest being in existence. Giganash has done exactly so, piloting a nice sturdy mech to bravely crush Zobos in the way. The world isn't so scary after all!
lore.zh: 缺乏安全感的最终解法，就是自己成为最强的存在！它驾驶着结实漂亮的机甲，勇敢地碾碎挡路的臭臭。只要火力足够猛，这世界就没有什么好怕的！

description.en: Shoots an Electricage orb that deals small AoE damage and creates an Electricage. Fires piercing signals towards the Electricage after, creating an electric surge that deals AoE damage upon impact. Gigagnash carries Aura: Lightning whenever on the field.
description.zh: 发射电笼球，造成小范围伤害并创造「电笼」。随后向「电笼」发射可穿透的信号球，命中「电笼」时电涌造成范围伤害。拥有「光环-电」

text.en: Deals small AoE damage continuously and inflicts additional effects on some affected enemies. If targets are bosses or other Tatari, reduces their ATK Speed and Move Speed; if not, inflicts Bind.
text.zh: 造成小范围持续伤害，并对其中部分敌人造成额外效果。若目标为首领或其他塔塔时，降低攻速与移动速度，否则造成「禁锢」

text.en: Boosts ATK Speed for all allies. The effect for non-Lightning allies is reduced by 50%. Aura: Lightning can be stacked, but cannot take effect in some game modes.
text.zh: 提升所有伙伴的攻速。其他元素伙伴的提升效果为电元素伙伴的50%。「光环-电」可叠加以增强效果。在部分玩法中不生效

text.en: When a skill targets another Tatari, the skill's base damage is multiplied by an Arena Factor, which varies depending on the skill.
text.zh: 当目标为其他塔塔时，技能伤害将在原始伤害基础上乘以「竞技系数」。不同技能的竞技系数各不相同

name.zh: 四阶通用光环（不用翻译）

lore.en: Dolphie loves chasing clouds on sunny days, skimming across the sea as the world brightens under sunlight. The sky's a perfect shade of blue today, and Dolphie's mood couldn't be better.
lore.zh: 晴天时最喜欢追着掠过海面的云影，任由阳光将一切染得明亮。天空蓝得恰到好处，今天的心情也同样如此。

text.en: Purchase any 5 buildings. Dolphie's in a great mood today!
text.zh: 购买5个任意建筑，今天也是好心情！

description.en: Launches sound waves that provide healing and grant stackable Joysong: DMG Boost to allies in their path.
description.zh: 发射音波，治疗途中伙伴并给予可叠加的「欢歌-增伤」

text.en: Deals increased damage. Stacks are reduced over time.
text.zh: 造成的伤害提升，层数会随时间衰减

description.en: Periodically summons a rainbow, granting Rainsong: HP Boost to nearby allies.
description.zh: 周期性召唤彩虹，并给予范围内伙伴「虹歌-生命提升」

description.en: Launches piercing bubbles, dealing large AoE damage and applying stackable Bubblesong: Fragile. Bubbles bounce when they hit the edge of the battlefield.
description.zh: 吹出可穿透的泡沫，造成大范围伤害和可叠加的「沫歌-易伤」。泡沫接触战场边缘时可反弹

description.en: Unleashes ocean waves that deal AoE damage and inflict Stun, while healing allies and granting Wavesong: ATK & DEF Boost. When a wave hits an ally, it extends forward and amplifies subsequent waves.
description.zh: 掀起海浪，造成范围伤害和「眩晕」，治疗伙伴并给予「浪歌-攻防提升」。命中伙伴后向前延伸，并使后续海浪变强

lore.en: Each time Blubbles returns to the bay, small wooden planks carrying flowers and seashells float across the water. The petals scatter and drift as Blubbles swims through, leaving the harbor a little livelier than before.
lore.zh: 每次回到海湾，水面上总会漂来载着鲜花与贝壳的小木板。它游过这条缤纷的水路，花瓣随浪散开，港口也比往日热闹了几分。

text.en: Feed Blubbles to increase stats 3 times.
text.zh: 通过喂养提升漫游海豚的属性3次

text.en: Use Fishing Rod x2000 in the Fishing Contest.
text.zh: 钓鱼大赛中消耗2000个鱼竿

lore.en: When Aquariel leaps out of water, the vibrant colors of rainbows would follow, skipping across the waves and into the distance. For those who are lucky enough to witness it, it is believed that good fortune will soon arrive on the sea breeze.
lore.zh: 跃出海面时会扬起一道横跨天际的彩虹，七色光芒顺着浪潮铺向远方。目睹这一幕的人们相信，好运也正循着海风悄然靠近。

Use Fishing Rod x6000 in the Fishing Contest.
text.zh: 钓鱼大赛中消耗6000个鱼竿

lore.en: As light pours down from the sky, Irisia returns from the depths of the thunderstorm, parting massive waves to clear a safe path. As long as Irisia still roams these seas, the lights of every home along the shore will stay on, steady and bright.
lore.zh: 天光倾泻，它从风暴深处归来，层层巨浪为它让开航路。只要那道身影仍在海上巡游，岸上的万家灯火便可平安长明。

lore.en: The outside world was almost within reach, but no matter what Popa tried, the window wouldn't budge. Nothing to do but stand tall, watch the sky grow dark, and just let things be.
lore.zh: 外面的世界近在咫尺，它尝试了所有办法，窗户依然纹丝不动。它把爪子背到身后，看着天色逐渐昏沉，决定尊重事情的自然发展。

text.en: Obtain 1 more Popa Tatari via any means.
text.zh: 任意途径再获取1只听天鼠

description.en: Ponders possum life and carries Possum: DMG Reduction & Heal Reduction. Sometimes Plays Dead to continuously deal AoE damage nearby.
description.zh: 思考鼠生，拥有「鼠鼠-减伤及减疗」。有时会「装死」，对周围持续造成范围伤害

text.en: Damage taken and healing received are reduced.
text.zh: 受到的伤害和治疗降低

text.en: Activated after taking damage a certain number of times when other allies are present. Cannot be attacked in this state.
text.zh: 场上有其他伙伴时，受到一定次数的伤害后触发。无法被攻击

description.zh: 周期性偷懒，和1个伙伴交换位置，并给予它「该你了-增伤」

lore.en: The responsibility that comes with a baby isn't something that can be canceled or delayed. Whenever Popapouch wants to take a break, a gentle tug would serve as a reminder that this is a job for life.
lore.zh: 背上多了一只幼崽，等于多了一项无法取消、不能延期的任务。刚想休息，小家伙就扯扯它的毛，提醒这份工作全日无休。

text.zh: 通过喂养提升不服鼠的属性3次

text.zh: 营地寻宝中挖开70个含宝藏的地块

lore.en: Whenever Popagrind hits the streets carrying the lil' ones, passing males would all turn to look. But this is nothing. Being a parent doesn't cost you your dignity, only your sleep—and raising two babies just makes the loss more complete.
lore.zh: 和幼崽一起出门时，路过的雄鼠纷纷侧目。它却表现得十分平静：带孩子不会丢掉尊严，只会丢掉睡眠；带两个，不过是丢得更彻底。

lore.zh: 从前，想不出办法便是事情的终点。如今，它会带着那些没有答案的问题继续向前。时间一长，就学会了如何承担。

text.zh: 受到的伤害和治疗降低

text.en: Activated after taking damage a certain number of times when other allies are present. Cannot be attacked in this state.
text.zh: 场上有其他伙伴时，受到一定次数的伤害后触发。无法被攻击

text.en: ATK and DEF are increased based on the caster's ATK and DEF.
text.zh: 攻击和防御提升。提升数值基于来源的攻击和防御

text.en: Provides DMG Reduction for all allies. The effect for non-Rock allies is reduced by 50%. Aura: Rock can be stacked, but cannot take effect in some game modes.
text.zh: 提升所有伙伴的减伤。其他元素伙伴的提升效果为岩元素伙伴的50%。「光环-岩」可叠加以增强效果。在部分玩法中不生效

text.en: When a skill targets another Tatari, the skill's base damage is multiplied by an Arena Factor, which varies depending on the skill.
text.zh: 当目标为其他塔塔时，技能伤害将在原始伤害基础上乘以「竞技系数」。不同技能的竞技系数各不相同

name.en: 四阶通用光环（不用翻译）
name.zh: 四阶通用光环（不用翻译）

description.en: Periodically recovers HP or heals the ally with lowest HP.
description.zh: 周期性治疗自己或最虚弱的伙伴

description.en: Generates 3 Windows and continuously deals small AoE damage in front of them.
description.zh: 搬来3扇「窗户」，对窗前持续造成小范围伤害

description.en: Slacks off periodically to switch locations with 1 ally, granting them Your Turn: DMG Boost.
description.zh: 周期性偷懒，和1个伙伴交换位置，并给予它「该你了-增伤」
